verdict.rationale: Unleash ships an official MCP server that 'enables LLM-powered coding assistants to create and manage feature flags following Unleash best practices,' directly supporting natural-language operation via AI agents, and its docs also expose an llms.txt for agent consumption. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the MCP server reliably interprets natural-language commands, and richer documentation of supported command scope beyond flag creation/management.
